description:
Counting and math practice for preschool and elementary school.
Rechenzwerge is a practice app for preschool and elementary school kids.

Practice math
- Number range up to 10, 20, 100 or 1000
- Addition, subtraction, multiplication and division
- Practice sessions with 10, 50 or 100 tasks
- Mistakes are fine: try again or show the solution

Practice counting (for the youngest)
- Count quantities up to 5, 10 or 20 – no digits, no reading
- Answer by tapping dice faces instead of numbers
- Two modes: dice pips or counting board

Motivation
- Build your own mascot (colors, head, accessories) that cheers you on

And also
- No ads, no tracking, no permissions
- All practice data stays on the device
